sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO, STATUS, CASE WHEN STATUS = 'D' THEN DOC_SEQ ELSE NULL END AS DOC_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE ='KRKUMHG001') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND (BUYER, DOC_NO) NOT IN ( SELECT BUYER,REF_NO FROM ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE = 'KRKUMHG001' ) AND CHANGE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-90,'YYYYMMDD') AND STATUS != 'D' AND RECV_FLAG = 'PS' AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND DOC_NO = PRDT.REF_NO ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND DOC_NO = PRDT.REF_NO AND DOC_SEQ= PRDT.REF_SEQ ) GROUP BY BUYER,REF_NO ) ) GROUP BY BUYER, DOC_NO, STATUS, DOC_SEQ ORDER BY BUYER, DOC_NO,STATUS

SELECT STATUS AS STAU ,BUYER AS BUYER ,DOC_NO AS DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ AS DOC_SEQ ,CASE WHEN STATUS = 'I' THEN DOC_NO ELSE LEGACY_PO_NO END AS LEBELN ,LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEBELP ,KEY_1 AS ACCTASSCAT ,CASE WHEN KEY_1 != ' ' THEN ACCOUNT_TYPE ELSE NULL END AS GL_ACCOUNT ,CASE WHEN KEY_1 = 'K' THEN BUDGET_DEPT WHEN KEY_1 = 'P' THEN KEY_4 ELSE NULL END AS COSTCENTER ,PLANT AS WERKS ,KEY_2 AS EKGRP ,'2400' AS STGE_LOC ,KEY_3 AS INFNR ,BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR ,SPECIFICATION AS TXZ01 ,ITEM_QTY AS MENGE ,UNIT_PRICE AS NETPR ,UNIT_MEASURE AS NETPRQ ,'KRW' AS WAERS ,'0000113157' AS LIFNR ,'A330' AS ZTERM ,REQ_USER_NAME AS PREQ_NAME ,'V1' AS MWSKZ ,'N' AS TEXT1 ,'' AS TEXT2 ,'N' AS TEXT3 ,'' AS TEXT4 ,'N' AS TEXT5 ,'' AS TEXT6 ,'' AS TEXT7 ,'NB' AS BSART ,'Z04' AS INCO1 ,'' AS INCO2 ,RD_DATE AS EEIND ,'' AS KDATB ,'' AS KDATE ,'' AS TESX2 ,EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND STATUS = #STATUS#
AND DOC_SEQ = #DOC_SEQ#
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(DOC_SEQ)

UPDATE ICOMPRDT T SET T.LEGACY_PO_NO = #EBELN#, T.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = ( SELECT S.NEW_LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM ( SELECT BUYER, REF_NO, REF_SEQ, LPAD( TO_CHAR( ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REF_SEQ) ) * 10 ), 5, '0' ) AS NEW_LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND REF_NO = #DOC_NO# AND RECV_FLAG = 'PS' AND STATUS != 'D' ) S WHERE S.BUYER = T.BUYER AND S.REF_NO = T.REF_NO AND S.REF_SEQ = T.REF_SEQ ) WHERE T.BUYER = #BUYER# AND T.REF_NO = #DOC_NO# AND T.RECV_FLAG = 'PS' AND T.STATUS != 'D'
